item.title: Uzbekistan Digital Health Platform - Integrations version 0.7.0
item.description: First published release: Ministry of Health forms 011, 066, 066-1 and 130 profiled as FHIR documents, and the DHIS tuberculosis integration. Numbering starts at 0.7.0 so the guide matches the UZ Core release it is built against.
item.dc:creator: Vadim Peretokin

item.title: Uzbekistan Digital Health Platform - Integrations version 0.8.0
item.description: Adds the narcology and psychiatry registries, and extends cervical and breast cancer screening with the pathology, breast imaging and screening document pathways. Built against UZ Core 0.8.0, which brings breaking changes.
item.dc:creator: Vadim Peretokin
